title: 第7章 苍澜仙宫第8章 太初峰
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
这次周岁宴，让朔衡赚了个盆满钵满。
朔涯把那些宾客送来的东西全部塞进了一个超大的储物戒指里，然后把储物戒指交给了他。
里面还有朔家的人送给他的生辰礼物，包括他爹他妈和他二叔，以及那位九祖。
基本上算是把他修炼前期的资源给包圆了——还要多出许多。
朔衡也没跟他们客气。
人家给了，他就收着，没什么不好意思的。
“这小子……”朔涯看着朔衡拿完钱就不理人的样子，无语的喝了口茶，“这财迷的性格真不知道随了谁了。”
晏情噗嗤一笑，觉得这个场面颇为有趣。
……
彼时，宾客几乎散尽。
大殿里就剩下了朔家和苍澜仙宫的人。
见仙宫宫主没有离开的意思，依旧坐在席上喝灵酒，朔涯就知道这位大概是有事找他。
于是他对一旁的朔阳使个眼色，示意他把不相干的朔家人带出去。
朔阳暗暗点头，转身开始安排。
很快，朔家大殿里只剩下了六个人。
苍凛知道，这事儿是该他开口的时候了。
“听闻贵子天生风雷之体。
今日一见，果然名不虚传，连浊器也争相认主。”苍凛笑笑。
他跟朔家的九祖朔古，关系很好。
是能坐下一同把酒言欢探讨武学的那种知己好友。

这对于修士来说，漫长的寿命中能有几个一直存在的朋友，是件幸事，所以苍凛对这份情谊很是珍惜。
此刻的夸赞，也更显得真心实意。
朔涯立刻起身拱手：“苍宫主谬赞了，这小子也就天赋算点好，性子实在顽劣的很。”
“朔衡年纪小，顽皮些，也是常事。”苍凛倒是觉得这孩子的性格挺讨喜的，刚刚他跟朔涯之间的小动作，苍凛都看在眼里。
是个有趣的孩子。
“待他六岁测完灵根后，来吾苍澜仙宫拜师如何？
届时，我会收他为……”
苍凛后面的话还没说完，就见他身后那位平平无奇的老人蓦然抬手，一巴掌拍在苍凛的后背上。
啪的一声。
清脆响亮。
“……”苍凛沉默了一下。
后背很疼，但是他依旧维持着身为一位顶尖势力的宫主形象，没有疼的在众人面前叫出来，也没做出什么扭曲的表情。
不过现在也没人关注苍凛的表现就是了。
朔衡看见，那位一直若有若无打量自己的老头，身形一闪就出现在他身边。
朔衡并不害怕，反而一动不动，饶有兴致的看着他。
朔涯原本是被洺万里身边的气息波动屏蔽了感知，一直以为这就是一位苍凛带来的普通仆从。
如今洺万里不再隐藏，朔涯自然也就认出了这人究竟是谁。
content_en:
This first birthday party made Shuo Heng a lot of money.
Shuo Ya stuffed all the things sent by the guests into an oversized storage ring, and then handed the storage ring to him.
There were also birthday gifts given to him by people from the Shuo family, including his father, his mother, his second uncle, and the ninth ancestor.
Basically, he has rounded up the resources he had in the early stage of cultivation - there are still many more.
Shuo Heng was not polite to them either.
If someone gave it to him, he would just keep it. There was nothing embarrassing about it.
"This kid..." Shuo Ya looked at Shuo Heng and ignored him after taking the money, and took a sip of tea speechlessly, "This money-obsessed character really doesn't know who he followed."
Yan Qing chuckled, finding this scene quite interesting.
…
At that time, the guests were almost gone.
Only people from the Shuo family and Canglan Immortal Palace were left in the hall.
Seeing that the master of the Immortal Palace had no intention of leaving and was still sitting at the banquet drinking spiritual wine, Shuo Ya knew that this person probably wanted to see him for something.
So he winked at Shuoyang on the side and motioned him to take out the irrelevant Shuo family members.
Shuoyang nodded secretly and turned around to start making arrangements.
Soon, there were only six people left in the Shuo family hall.
Cang Lin knew that it was time for him to speak up about this matter.
"I heard that Takako was born with a body of wind and thunder.
When I saw him today, his reputation was indeed well-deserved. Even the turbid vessels rushed to recognize him. "Cang Lin smiled.
He has a very good relationship with Shuo Gu, the ninth ancestor of the Shuo family.
He is the kind of close friend who can sit down and have a drink and discuss martial arts together.
For a monk, it is a blessing to have a few friends who will always be there in a long life, so Cang Lin cherishes this friendship very much.
The praise at this moment also seemed more sincere.
Shuo Ya immediately stood up and held his hands in his hands: "Palace Master Cang is so complimentary. This guy only has some talent, but his temper is really naughty."
"Shuo Heng is young and is naughty, which is normal." Cang Lin found this child's personality quite lovable. Cang Lin saw all the little actions between him and Shuo Ya just now.
He's an interesting kid.
"How about he come to our Canglan Immortal Palace to become a disciple after he tests his spiritual roots at the age of six?
At that time, I will accept him as..."
Before Cang Lin could finish what he said, the ordinary old man behind him suddenly raised his hand and slapped Cang Lin on the back.
There was a snap.
Crisp and loud.
"..." Cang Lin was silent for a moment.
His back hurt, but he still maintained his image as a top-notch palace master. He didn't cry out in front of everyone in pain, nor did he make any distorted expressions.
But no one is paying attention to Cang Lin's performance now.
Shuo Heng saw that the old man who had been looking at him casually appeared beside him in a flash.
Shuo Heng was not afraid. Instead, he remained motionless and looked at him with interest.
Shuo Ya was originally blocked by the aura fluctuations around Ming Wanli, and always thought that this was an ordinary servant brought by Cang Lin.
Now that Ming Wanli was no longer hiding, Shuo Ya naturally recognized who this person was.
